audio.text: Hi, Neil. I just heard that the Hartley account is moving its order up by two weeks.
Two weeks? That's going to strain the warehouse. We're already short on packing staff.
I know. Could we bring in some temporary workers from an agency?
It's an option, though they'd need training, and that takes a couple of days.
Then let's start right away. I'll call the agency and ask for six people by Monday.
And I'll let the client know we'll confirm the date once we see how many we get.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?

why.vi: Khách hàng muốn đơn hàng sớm hơn hai tuần, tức là đơn gấp.
why.en: The client wants the order earlier, a rush order.

questions.trap: Chưa có gì bị hư hay hủy.

questions.q: What is mentioned as a drawback of hiring temporary workers?

why.vi: Họ phải được đào tạo mất vài ngày.
why.en: Training takes a couple of days.

questions.trap: Chi phí không được đề cập.

questions.q: What will the woman do next?

why.vi: Cô sẽ gọi công ty cung ứng nhân sự.
why.en: She will call the staffing agency.

questions.trap: Anh Neil sẽ báo khách hàng.

audio.text: Hi, Karen. I'm having trouble with the new accounting software. It keeps logging me out.
It did the same to me yesterday. IT told us to clear the browser cache.
I tried that, and it didn't help. Do you think I should reinstall it?
It's a web application, so there's nothing to reinstall. Why not submit a help ticket? They respond within a few hours.
Okay. But I have to send the payroll report before five.
Then use my computer for now. I'm in meetings until three.

questions.q: What is the man’s problem?

why.vi: Phần mềm liên tục đăng xuất anh ra.
why.en: The software keeps logging him out.

questions.trap: Anh không quên mật khẩu.

questions.q: Why does the woman say reinstalling is unnecessary?

why.vi: Đó là ứng dụng web nên không có gì để cài lại.
why.en: A web application runs online and is not installed.

questions.trap: Cô không nói bản cập nhật hôm qua.

questions.q: What does the woman offer?

why.vi: Cô cho anh dùng máy của cô trong lúc chờ.
why.en: She offers her computer for now.

questions.trap: Ticket là cô khuyên anh tự gửi.

audio.text: Good morning. I called a meeting because we've received three complaints about the new cafeteria schedule.
I've heard them too. People say lunch ends too early at one-thirty.
Honestly, that was my decision. We were losing money in the afternoons.
I understand, but employees on the late shift can't get a hot meal.
What if we keep the main counter open until two, and use only the snack bar after that?
That could work. I'd have to check the cost of the extra staff hours.
Please do, and send the numbers to us by Thursday.

questions.q: What is the meeting about?

why.vi: Có phàn nàn về giờ phục vụ mới của căng tin.
why.en: Staff complain about the new cafeteria hours.

questions.trap: Giá thực đơn không được nhắc.

questions.q: Why was the schedule changed?

why.vi: Buổi chiều quán đang lỗ tiền.
why.en: They were losing money in the afternoons.

questions.trap: Điện không được nhắc.

questions.q: What will the second man do?

why.vi: Anh sẽ kiểm tra chi phí giờ làm thêm của nhân viên rồi gửi số liệu.
why.en: He will check the cost, i.e. calculate expenses.

questions.trap: Quầy snack vẫn mở theo đề xuất.

audio.text: Excuse me, I'm looking for a gift for my sister. She just started her first job as a nurse.
Congratulations to her! How much would you like to spend?
Around fifty dollars. Something practical, maybe.
These insulated water bottles are very popular with hospital staff. They keep drinks cold for twenty-four hours.
That's useful. Can you engrave her name on it?
We can, but it takes three days. If you need it sooner, I'd suggest this one, which comes with a free sleeve.
I can wait. I'll take the engraved one.

questions.q: What is the man doing?

why.vi: Anh tìm quà cho em gái mới đi làm.
why.en: He is looking for a gift.

questions.trap: Anh không trả hàng.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the bottles?
options: They keep temperatures for a long time

why.vi: Giữ lạnh 24 giờ, tức là giữ nhiệt lâu.
why.en: Cold for 24 hours means it holds temperature a long time.

questions.trap: Giảm giá không được nhắc.

questions.q: What does the man imply about the engraving?

why.vi: Anh nói anh có thể chờ, nghĩa là chấp nhận việc chậm.
why.en: He can wait, so the delay is acceptable.

questions.trap: Không ai nói về giá khắc tên.

audio.text: Good afternoon, Tidewater Aquarium. This is Mia.
Hello, I'm calling on behalf of Oakridge Primary. We'd like to bring sixty children on a field trip next month.
That's wonderful. We recommend splitting larger groups into two, so the exhibits don't get crowded.
Understandable. Are there any educational materials for the teachers?
Yes, we email a free activity booklet after you book. Lunch can be arranged in our café, or the children can bring their own.
Bringing their own would be best. Could you reserve the eleventh of March?
Let me check the calendar. I'll confirm by email this afternoon.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?

why.vi: Anh gọi để đặt chuyến tham quan cho học sinh.
why.en: He wants to book a field trip.

questions.trap: Lunch chỉ là chi tiết kèm theo.

questions.q: What does the woman recommend?

why.vi: Cô khuyên chia nhóm lớn làm hai.
why.en: She suggests splitting the group in two.

questions.trap: Không nói phải trả trước.

questions.q: What will the woman do this afternoon?

why.vi: Cô sẽ kiểm tra lịch và xác nhận qua email.
why.en: She will check the calendar and confirm by email.

questions.trap: Booklet gửi sau khi đặt chỗ.

audio.text: Hi, Joanna. Have you looked at the budget report I sent on Monday?
I did. Overall it's fine, but the travel line looks too high for this time of year.
That's because of the sales conference in Chicago. It's included in the number.
Right, but we agreed to hold that event virtually. Didn't the CEO approve it?
He did, and I forgot to remove it. I'll recalculate right now.
Thanks. Send me a new version before our two o'clock meeting.

questions.q: What is the conversation mainly about?
options: An error in a financial document

why.vi: Báo cáo ngân sách còn dòng chi phí đi lại không đúng.
why.en: The budget report still has an incorrect travel cost.

questions.trap: Hội nghị chỉ là nguyên nhân gây sai số.

questions.q: What does the man imply about the conference?
options: It will no longer be held in person

why.vi: Hội nghị được quyết định tổ chức trực tuyến, nên không còn trực tiếp.
why.en: It will be virtual, no longer in person.

questions.trap: Chicago là địa điểm cũ, không phải nơi mới.

questions.q: What will the man do next?

why.vi: Anh sẽ tính lại ngay.
why.en: He will recalculate right now.

questions.trap: CEO đã duyệt rồi nên anh không cần gọi.

audio.text: Hello. I'm calling to ask about the free-delivery offer on your website.
Certainly. Orders over eighty dollars qualify, as long as the delivery address is within the city limits.
I'm ordering a bookshelf for our office, which is across the river in Eastbrook.
Eastbrook is outside the limits, I'm afraid. The delivery charge there is twelve dollars.
That's fine. When could it arrive?
We have a truck in your area on Thursday. If I enter your order now, it will be on that route.
Please do. And can the driver assemble it?
For ten dollars extra, yes.

questions.q: What is the woman’s purpose in calling?
options: To find out about a delivery promotion

why.vi: Cô hỏi về ưu đãi giao hàng miễn phí.
why.en: She asks about the free-delivery offer.

questions.trap: Cô chưa có đơn bị mất.

questions.q: Why will the woman be charged for delivery?
options: Her office is outside a specific area

why.vi: Eastbrook nằm ngoài giới hạn thành phố.
why.en: Eastbrook is outside the city limits.

questions.trap: Giá trị đơn chưa được nói là nhỏ.

questions.q: What additional service might the woman pay for?

why.vi: Thêm 10 đô để tài xế lắp ráp.
why.en: Ten dollars for the driver to assemble it.

questions.trap: Tốc độ giao hàng không được tính thêm phí.

audio.text: Lisa, I'm looking at the conference room schedule for next week. Who booked the big room on Tuesday morning?
That was me. We have a client from Seoul coming for a presentation.
The thing is, I booked it, too, for the staff training. I think the system allowed a double booking.
Hmm. My meeting is more urgent, but I don't mind if you use the lounge on the fifth floor.
The lounge can't fit our group of twenty. Could we do it in the afternoon instead?
The room's free after one. I'll update the calendar and tell you when it's done.

questions.q: What problem do the speakers discuss?

why.vi: Hai người đặt trùng phòng họp vào sáng thứ Ba.
why.en: Both booked the same room, a scheduling conflict.

questions.trap: Không có thiết bị hỏng.

questions.q: Why is the lounge not suitable?

why.vi: Phòng chờ không chứa nổi nhóm 20 người.
why.en: It cannot fit twenty people.

questions.trap: Không nói nó ồn.

questions.q: What will the woman do?

why.vi: Cô sẽ cập nhật lịch.
why.en: She will update the calendar.

questions.trap: Khách đến vào sáng thứ Ba, không đổi.

audio.text: Dr. Silva's office. How may I help you?
Hi, this is Peter Grant. I got a letter saying my medical insurance has changed, and I'm not sure my plan covers my regular visits.
May I have your member number?
It's on the card, but I left it at work. Could I call back this afternoon?
Of course. In the meantime, I'd suggest checking the provider's website. They list the clinics that accept each plan.
I'll do that. Is there a charge if I have to cancel next Monday's appointment?
Not if you let us know twenty-four hours in advance.

questions.q: Why does the man call?

why.vi: Anh lo gói bảo hiểm mới có chi trả cho các lần khám không.
why.en: He wonders whether his insurance covers visits.

questions.trap: Chưa nói đến phẫu thuật.

questions.q: Why can the woman not look up the man’s information now?
options: He does not have a number with him

why.vi: Anh để thẻ ở chỗ làm, nên không có số hội viên.
why.en: He left his card at work.

questions.trap: Hệ thống không được nói là hỏng.

questions.q: What does the woman imply about cancellations?

why.vi: Báo trước 24 giờ thì không bị tính phí.
why.en: Twenty-four hours’ notice means no charge.

questions.trap: Không nói cần mẫu đơn.

audio.text: Becky, did you notice the revenue chart in today's report? Our online sales are up, but the in-store numbers are down.
That's the trend this quarter. Which location is struggling the most?
Look at the table. The Westfield store has the biggest decline, even though it's in the busiest mall.
Interesting. Maybe the parking fees at Westfield are putting people off.
Possibly. Either way, I think we should send a survey to customers there before we make changes.
Agreed. Can you draft the questions by Friday?

questions.q: What are the speakers discussing?

why.vi: Họ bàn về doanh số cửa hàng giảm.
why.en: In-store numbers are down.

questions.trap: Online tăng chứ không giảm.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which store is the speakers’ main concern?

why.vi: Westfield giảm nhiều nhất (18 phần trăm).
why.en: Westfield has the largest drop, 18 percent.

questions.trap: Central Plaza giảm ít hơn.

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?

why.vi: Cô nhờ anh soạn câu hỏi khảo sát.

audio.text: Tony, I need your opinion on the layout for the new employee handbook. Take a look at the page map.
It looks organized. But where's the section on vacation days? People ask about that the most.
It's under the benefits chapter, which comes right after the safety rules.
That's too far back. Can we place benefits right after the introduction?
Hmm. Then the safety chapter would move down. I suppose that's fine, as long as the code of conduct stays third.
Perfect. I'll let the designer know.

questions.q: What are the speakers discussing?
options: Arranging the contents of a document

why.vi: Họ sắp xếp thứ tự các chương của cuốn sổ tay.
why.en: They are organizing the handbook layout.

questions.trap: Vacation chỉ là nội dung cần dễ tìm.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which chapter will probably be moved to the second position?

why.vi: Benefits được chuyển lên ngay sau phần giới thiệu, tức là vị trí thứ hai.
why.en: Benefits goes right after the introduction, position two.

questions.trap: Code of Conduct giữ ở vị trí thứ ba.

questions.q: What will the man do next?

why.vi: Anh sẽ báo cho nhà thiết kế.
why.en: He will tell the designer.

questions.trap: Chưa in gì.

audio.text: Hello, Ms. Ito. I'm calling from Northgate Auto. Your car is ready for pickup.
That was quick. I thought it would take until Friday.
The part arrived early. But we also found that your brake pads were worn, so I replaced them as well.
Oh. Did you check with me first? That wasn't in the estimate.
I'm sorry. I left a message yesterday, but I may have used the wrong number. I can take twenty dollars off the labor charge.
That's fair. I'll come by at five.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
options: To say a vehicle is finished

why.vi: Xe đã sẵn sàng để nhận.
why.en: Her car is ready for pickup.

questions.trap: Anh chưa đặt phụ tùng mới.

questions.q: What is the woman unhappy about?
options: A missed call from her bank

why.vi: Việc thay má phanh không có trong bản dự toán.
why.en: The brake work was not in the estimate.

questions.trap: Xe xong sớm hơn dự kiến.

questions.q: What does the man offer?

why.vi: Anh giảm 20 đô tiền công.
why.en: Twenty dollars off the labor charge.

audio.text: Carlos, the quarterly inspection is next week. Is the cold storage room ready?
The temperature's fine, but the log sheet is a mess. Two of the readings were written in the wrong column.
The inspector will check that first. Can you reprint the sheet and copy the numbers by hand?
I'd rather correct the original and initial the changes, so nothing looks altered.
You're right, that's the proper procedure. Who else has access to the log?
Only me and Dana. I'll ask her to review it with me tomorrow.

questions.q: What are the speakers preparing for?

why.vi: Họ chuẩn bị cho đợt kiểm tra định kỳ.
why.en: The quarterly inspection is an official check.

questions.trap: Không có sự kiện nào khác.

questions.q: Why does the man prefer to correct the original sheet?

why.vi: Sửa bản gốc và ký tắt để không bị nghi ngờ làm giả số liệu.
why.en: Initialing corrections keeps the record honest.

questions.trap: Tiết kiệm giấy không phải lý do được nói.

questions.q: What will the man do tomorrow?
options: Go over the record with a coworker

why.vi: Anh sẽ xem lại bảng ghi cùng Dana.
why.en: He will review the log with Dana.

questions.trap: Nhiệt độ vẫn ổn.
